name: manual_75f7ea
claim: Before rotating any credential in response to another agent's 'push blocked by stale/exposed credential' report, verify the actual failure first: run 'gh auth status' and a 'git push --dry-run' in the current session. A report from a different agent session is frequently a shadowed/stale GITHUB_TOKEN env var in THAT session's shell, not a genuinely compromised or expired credential -- this repo's own convention of unsetting GITHUB_TOKEN before every gh/git call already avoids the failure mode being reported.

decisions.notes: 2026-09-12: a handoff report claimed a stale Git HTTPS credential blocked push to oramasys/agate PR #2, recommending rotation. Verified directly instead of rotating -- gh auth status showed a valid active keyring token, and a dry-run push succeeded cleanly. Pushed the actual commit with zero auth issues. Rotating a working credential on an unverified report would have been unnecessary churn and a real security-adjacent action taken without cause.
